sleeping_bag.name: AERIAL 330
sleeping_bag.subtitle: ultralight down sleeping bag with specialized construction
sleeping_bag.description: Aerial 330 is described by Cumulus as an extremely light false-bottom down sleeping bag with specialized construction for users seeking the highest possible weight-to-insulation ratio without giving up comfort.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 485 g total weight on France capture
- 330 g of 900 FP down
- Comfort -1 C / limit -7 C
- Specialized false-bottom construction
- Minimalist design
- No zipper
- Toray Airtastic fabric family mentioned for the Aerial series
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: The Aerial series is positioned for discerning adventurers, extreme adventure pursuits, long-distance cycling races, and multi-day hikes in technical terrain where every gram matters.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Extreme adventure pursuits, long-distance cycling races, multi-day hikes in technical terrain, lightweight-focused adventures.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: User-provided France capture shows 415 EUR, 485 g, 330 g down, comfort -1 C, limit -7 C. Indexed official Cumulus category snippets found online showed 399 EUR and 483 g for older crawls.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Lifetime Experience warranty shown on official pages.
